title: Eastern Arc Mountains
significance: Ancient forest islands rising from the Tanzanian lowlands – globally important for endemics evolved in isolation over millions of years.

blocks.name: Udzungwa & Kilombero block
blocks.routeNote: Strongest southern arc module – links Iringa, Udzungwa, Kilombero and miombo legs.

blocks.name: Uluguru & Ukaguru
blocks.routeNote: Often approached from Morogoro–Iringa corridors; trail mud and fitness shape daily pace.

blocks.name: Rubeho & Rondo
blocks.habitats: High arc ridges, coastal forest remnants
blocks.routeNote: Low-traffic forests for travellers who want quiet endemics away from main highways.

blocks.name: Usambara (East & West)
blocks.routeNote: Northeastern modules – combines with Pemba or northern parks on long tours.

routePractical: Southern arc tours stack forest days before long miombo drives – altitude and mud dictate footwear, not daily lists.
Northeastern arc tours often fly or drive to Usambara after Dar or Arusha starters – lodge nights split forest blocks.
We do not promise every block on one departure – targets and fitness choose the subset.
